hero.intro: A website for a practice with a wide range of services, organized so every client finds what they need straight away.
hero.ctaLabel: I want a project like this

client.title: Meet Proj.System
client.text: Proj.System is a multidisciplinary practice founded in Porcia, Italy, in 2001. Its engineers, architects, surveyors, industrial specialists and safety experts cover design, construction and workplace safety, instrumental testing, technical consulting and training.
client.challengeText: A very wide range of services for very different audiences: companies, public bodies, private clients and trainees. The risk was a confusing website, where anyone looking for one specific service gets lost in the pages.
challengePoints: A large team of professionals to showcase
Courses and training to promote and update regularly

solution.title: What I built
solution.text: Structure first, design second: every decision starts from who will use the website and what they need to find.

items.title: Services in four areas
items.text: Engineering and architecture, Safety, Instrumental testing, Training: every visitor heads straight to the right area.

items.title: The team in the spotlight
items.text: A page dedicated to the professionals, with their roles and expertise: trust starts with people.

items.title: Consultation requests always in view
items.text: The button to contact the practice is on every page, on phones too.

items.title: Blog and e-learning
items.text: News, in-depth articles and an online training area, all easy to update in-house.

showcase.title: The result, on every screen
showcase.text: Hover over the page to scroll through it.
showcase.scrollLabel: Scrollable preview of the Proj.System home page

results.title: What changed
before: A static website the firm couldn’t update themselves
after: A dynamic website, with every piece of content editable in-house
Detailed service pages, area by area
The team front and center, with roles and specialisms
A contact form and consultation request on every page

cta.title: Your project could be next
cta.text: Tell me about your business on a free 25-minute call: I’ll tell you how I’d approach it, how long it would take and the fixed price.
